timeline.convention: limit against the previous close (before v0.42.5)

reasons: the call is in force today (on or after its effective date)
the call is in force today (on or after its effective date)
the call is in force today (on or after its effective date)

mode: paper, autonomous, unhedged, no VIX sleeve (PSQ and VIXY are not in the price mirror)

convention.order: written by the daily pass, before the open on most days
convention.fill: the close of the first exchange session that ends after the order was written
convention.cost: 5 bp half-spread on every fill; no commission
convention.limit: the ticket's limit is recorded; the paper fill does not depend on it

note: A model account of $100,000 run by the trader from the daily workflow. Each order rests until the close of the first exchange session that ends after it was written and fills at that close with a 5 bp half-spread, so the price is never older than the order. The first 9 fills (written Nov 11, 2026) were made under the earlier convention, at the limit against the previous day's close: a price older than the order. They are kept as recorded and marked. A simulation convention, not evidence of an achievable execution. Not a personal account.
